column1: # ORIGINAL: the shards of tools/test_warm.sh (D-0059, 2026-10-20) — no swipl-devel counterpart.
# tools/test_warm_shards.tsv — how CI spreads tools/test_warm.sh over jobs: `tools/test_warm.sh shard NAME`
# runs the modes of that line in turn and prints `test_warm (shard NAME): P passed, F failed`. The default
# run (no argument) is `main` plus every other mode in one process, so the shards together run each case
# once; `total` is the default run's pass count, and tools/evidence_ci.py `warm` fails a run in which a
# shard is missing, ran nothing, failed, or the passes do not sum to it. MEASURED 2026-10-20: 211 passed,
# 0 failed (the whole run, locally, on a branch); the same run on main passed 212 (one case ran only there —
# fixed 2026-10-21: every ref now runs 212); 215 after the three sibling-mutant guard cases (2026-10-21). A case
# added or removed changes `total`: update it in the same commit,
# from the gather's own report.
# BALANCE (re-measured 2026-10-22 on main-push run 39802795515, the `tools/test_warm.sh shard` step alone): main 324 s,
# stale 334, fast 330, state 180, light 176 (+ 14 for tools/test_evidence.sh) — the job times (509-644 s) differ by the
# setup, 176-320 s, not by the shards. The three one-mode shards cannot be cut further by mode; `state` (rss structs)
# and `light` were merged into `light` (~370 s: one runner and its ~190 s setup fewer, under the 644 s of `main`). The
# gather's ::notice lists the passes per shard; a shard's seconds are in the job's step list (the jobs API).
#   shard<TAB>NAME<TAB>MODES (space-separated: main, rss, structs, fast, stale, refuse, inventory, noswipl,
